title: SUPERTWEETEVAL: A Challenging, Unified and Heterogeneous Benchmark for Social Media NLP Research
measurement_description: The paper measures the ability of language models to detect hate speech, where 'hate_religion' is one of the eight specific categories of hate speech identified. It evaluates overall model performance on the TWEETHATE task, which includes identifying if a tweet targets religion with hate speech.
findings: For the TWEETHATE task, which includes 'hate_religion' as a classification label, models generally perform well in the fine-tuning setting, with TimeLMLARGE achieving the best score of 82.54. Zero-shot and few-shot approaches generally struggle, although chat-gpt-3.5-turbo achieved a competitive zero-shot score of 63.42. The paper did not provide specific findings or performance breakdowns directly related to the 'hate_religion' sub-category.
